title: Kenya & Tanzania
overview_paragraphs:
This trip crosses two countries on one safari circuit, starting in Kenya with the Mount Kenya foothills, Lake Nakuru, and the Masai Mara, then crossing the border at Isebania into Tanzania for the Serengeti, Ngorongoro Crater, Lake Manyara, and Tarangire. It covers most of East Africa’s best-known game reserves in a single overland route.

Best for travelers who want a long, wildlife-led safari across both Kenya and Tanzania, with the Great Migration’s home territory at its center.

places.name: Aberdares & Mount Kenya
places.tagline: Highland country at the foot of Africa’s second-highest mountain
places.modal_tagline: WHERE THE SAFARI BEGINS, ABOVE THE PLAINS
places.desc: After arriving in Nairobi, the route heads north to the Aberdare and Mount Kenya region. The first full day is a quiet one, with country club grounds, cool highland air, and views of Mount Kenya when the weather is clear.

places.name: Lake Nakuru
places.tagline: A soda lake ringed by acacia woodland and wildlife
places.modal_tagline: THE FIRST GAME DRIVES OF THE TRIP
places.desc: Lake Nakuru National Park is known for its rich birdlife and its concentration of rhinos, buffalo, and big cats. The stay here includes a game drive on the way in and another in the afternoon.

places.name: Masai Mara
places.tagline: Kenya’s most famous reserve, open grassland as far as the eye can see
places.modal_tagline: TWO DAYS IN BIG CAT COUNTRY
places.desc: The Masai Mara anchors the Kenya leg with two days of morning and afternoon game drives across its open savannah, home to lion, elephant, and the herds that cross it during the migration.

places.name: Serengeti
places.tagline: Tanzania’s endless plains, reached by crossing the border
places.desc: The route crosses from Kenya into Tanzania at Isebania, picks up a Tanzanian guide, and drives into the Serengeti with game viewing along the way. Two days of game drives follow across one of the largest wildlife ecosystems in the world.

places.name: Ngorongoro Crater
places.tagline: A collapsed volcano that became a natural wildlife enclosure
places.desc: Ngorongoro’s crater floor packs lion, elephant, hippo, and flamingos into a single caldera. A half-day crater tour is followed by a late afternoon drive to Karatu.

places.name: Lake Manyara & Tarangire
places.tagline: A rift valley lake, then elephant country among the baobabs
places.modal_tagline: TWO MORE PARKS BEFORE THE FINISH
places.desc: Lake Manyara offers a game drive along its lake and forest edge, with a relaxed afternoon at the lodge. Tarangire follows, known for its big elephant herds and baobab-dotted landscape, before the final drive to Arusha.

inclusions: Full board meals at lodges & camps
Airport meet & greet and all transfers
